description: Lexicographically earliest infinite sequence such that a(i) = a(j) => A305974(i) = A305974(j), for all i, j >= 1, where A305974(1) = 1; and for n > 1, if n = p^k for some prime p and exponent k >= 1, then A305974(n) = -k, otherwise A305974(n) is the position of n in A361102, numbers that are not prime powers.
